name: Zigzag winding connection
summary: A zigzag winding interconnects portions of phase windings in a specified arrangement.
description: A zigzag winding interconnects portions of phase windings in a specified arrangement. Its neutral and zero-sequence behaviour depend on the actual transformer connection and ratings.
readingNotes: Use the manufacturer's winding diagram to identify all interconnections.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A zigzag winding is different from a three-phase star formed from one winding per phase.
